requests: In the CloudScale dashboard, add a Revoke button to each row of the Production API keys table. Clicking it should remove that key (persist it on the server through a new API route like the existing ones), and the Active keys count should go down by one. Keep the change small and consistent with the existing code.

t-1.title: Revoke KEY-001 and retain KEY-002 after reload
t-1.summary: Starting with KEY-001 and KEY-002, revoke KEY-001 using its row; observe that KEY-001 disappears, KEY-002 remains, Active keys changes from 2 to 1, and KEY-001 stays absent after a dashboard reload.

t-2.title: Revoke the last remaining KEY-002 and retain zero after reload
t-2.summary: After KEY-001 is revoked, revoke remaining KEY-002 from its row; observe that KEY-002 disappears, Active keys changes from 1 to 0, and KEY-002 stays absent after dashboard reload.
